nodes.cesarscy.text.t: "Asked, sure enough." Szkarad coughs. "They're hunting survivors of the slaughter up north, and anyone with island sulphur in his bag. They've passed me by so far, because I sit on a keg of powder and they know it. You'd best keep your head down. And if anything happens, shout. I'll make such a smoke your own mother won't find you."

nodes.pierwszy.text.t: "Iron that shoots. That's a good one." Szkarad spits the straw into the fire. "Pistols, handguns, bows, crossbows. Powder from the craftsmen's island, not from the neighbour's yard. Remember: a ball goes where it likes, not where you'd like. Especially after three mugs."

nodes.powitanie.options.[pierwszy].text.t: Good day, master. I hear you sell iron that shoots.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Behind a counter made from a powder keg sits a man black with soot up to the elbows. He's chewing a straw and sizing you up. "After powder, boy? If you've no coin, don't bother looking."

nodes.towar.text.t: Szkarad throws open a chest with such a bang that pots fall off the shelf. "Look, but don't touch if you can't pay. I ought to charge for looking too, but I'm feeling kind today."

nodes.twierdza_plotka.text.t: "The stronghold on the border, four days north. The imperial powder comes from there. An old fort, full of men who don't want to be seen. Take plenty of arrows and little talk."

nodes.wyspa_ok.text.t: Szkarad looks round to make sure nobody's listening. "The island craftsmen forge from a metal they don't know themselves. They say their fathers sailed down from the sky, in an iron boat. I don't hold with sky-tales, but I buy their powder. Hits nicely." He rubs his nose. "Just don't tell anyone you had it from me."

nodes.wyspa_test.options.[naciskaj].text.t: Out with it, master, or I won't buy.

nodes.wyspa_test.text.t: Szkarad narrows one eye and stays quiet longer than he should. "Where, where. From the island, I said."

nodes.wyspa_zle.text.t: Szkarad snorts like a horse at nettles. "You think I'll buy your tongue for two groats? Go ask a hog for advice, at least he doesn't play the wise man. The powder's mine, and where it's from is my business."

nodes.znowu.text.t: "Ah, you. The one who asks instead of buying." Szkarad wipes his hands on his apron. "Out with it, before my powder goes damp from your jabbering."
